title: Smooth schemes over fields are geometrically normal
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $X$ a scheme with a smooth morphism $X\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ [def-pc-scheme, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Then $X$ is geometrically regular, geometrically normal, and geometrically reduced over $k$: for every finite purely inseparable field extension $K'/k$ [def-pc-field-extension], the base change $X_{K'}=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}K'$ [def-pc-base-change] is regular [def-weil-regular-scheme]; for every field extension $K/k$, every local ring of $X_K$ is a normal domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] and $X_K$ is reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme].

proof.text: Fix any field extension $K/k$ and let $g:\operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be its spectrum map. The second projection $p:X_K\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ is smooth by clause (2) of [lem-pc-proper-base-change], implemented by the smooth base-change instance. Smoothness implies locally finite presentation [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], hence locally finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism].

The field $K$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], so its spectrum is locally Noetherian. Apply LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian, the local-Noetherian permanence recorded by [pqf-def-locnoeth], to $p$. This gives local Noetherianity of $X_K$ without quasi-compactness. Apply the already proved source-library theorem AlgebraicGeometry.IsRegular.of_smooth (the declaration attached to [lem-sc-smooth-regular], whose Lean statement works for every smooth scheme over a field). Its stalkwise regularity together with local Noetherianity is exactly IsRegularScheme [def-weil-regular-scheme]. Specialize this construction to any finite purely inseparable extension to obtain the first conjunct.

For every field extension $K/k$, retain the stalkwise IsRegular instance from Step 2. Every stalk is a domain by the regular-local-ring instance. Apply the proved source-library theorem IsRegular.isIntegrallyClosed_stalk, which realizes precisely clause (1) of [rem-pc-regular-normal] (Stacks 0569), to each stalk. This gives the required domain and integrally-closed conjunction. No normal-component decomposition, connectedness, dimension bound or quasi-compactness is used.

Domains are reduced, so the stalks in Step 3 are reduced. The theorem isReduced_of_isReduced_stalk, realizing [def-pc-reduced-scheme], gives reducedness of $X_K$. Combine this with Step 3 for the second conjunct. All stalk assertions are universally quantified and so also cover empty base changes.
